identity.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35229, 64-bit

audit_logs_constraints: audit_logs_actor_id_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
public_profiles_view:
public_profiles|postgres|{security_invoker=false}| SELECT id,
    username,
    display_name,
    avatar_url,
    bio,
    interests,
    github_url,
    linkedin_url,
    preferred_locale,
    created_at,
    role
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE NOT is_suspended OR ( SELECT is_moderator() AS is_moderator);
